sent_to_model:
I need help writing a review of Sweet Addiction. My husband finally took me after I'd wanted to go for months, and I came away pretty annoyed. I'd tried a similar place before and really thought he would enjoy this one. I want to include how much I'd been looking forward to going and what I liked about the shop, but also what happened while we were ordering and why the way the employees acted bothered me so much. I work in customer service myself and this was frustrating to watch. The review should cover the ice cream and cookies too, and make it clear why I won't be spending my money there again. It's for other customers to read online, around 500 words.

- Sweet Addiction sells cookies and ice cream.
- Cookie sundae menu description: two ice cream scoops, one cookie, hot fudge. Whipped cream wasn't mentioned.
- I've worked in customer service long enough to have expectations about how customers should be treated.
- Previously visited a similar business in Huntington Beach and really enjoyed it.
- Didn't see any employees wearing name tags.
- Modern, clean decor; paintings looked homemade, partly hidden behind the refrigerator containing water and soda.
- Very limited space around the ice cream counter; cookie storage shelf roughly two feet below ceiling.
- Had wanted to visit for months. Husband agreed to go; neither of us had been there before.
- Ice cream tasted somewhat freezer burnt, although otherwise okay. Cookies were hard.
- Had enthusiastically told my husband he would enjoy the cookie and ice cream combination before our visit.
- Strong cookie smell inside made me eager to pick my combination.
- Husband needed time with the menu. Employee directed us out of the ordering position; only one customer behind us, also undecided.
- Ordered cookie sundae with my ice cream and cookie choices, without fudge. Tall blonde employee offered whipped cream; I declined.
- Blonde employee corrected my order classification and told me to order separate scoops plus a cookie. Her manner felt insulting.
- Overheard that employee being rude to a different customer too.
- Male employee lingered between kitchen and counter, fiddling with whipped cream. Seemed to be avoiding his responsibilities.
- Liked the shop's appearance and arrived with high expectations.
- I understand why removing the toppings changes what counts as a sundae. The employee could still have handled it politely.
- Suspect cookies are made early and become hard from sitting uncovered all day; don't know their actual baking schedule.
- Employees avoiding work really irritates me.
- Main complaint: service rather than food. Felt dismissed and belittled.
- Other customers should understand both the food quality and how we were treated.
- Make clear that the employees' attitude is why I don't intend to return.

(About me: customer service worker. Length: it should come to roughly 400-800 words.)

must_cover: The writer had high expectations and liked the shop's appearance.
The husband was told to step aside while deciding; after the writer requested no fudge and declined whipped cream, an employee dismissively told her to order separate scoops and a cookie.
The ice cream was somewhat freezer burnt and the cookies were hard.
Poor service is the main reason the writer will not return.
The writer connects frustration with the employees to her own customer-service experience.
